_meta.description: Grouped Process aggregating revenue by month decorated with an OVERLAY_YOY group overlay that scores each month against the same month one year prior (current_month / month-12-prior * 100). The orders.pulse cohort spans the 2025 calendar year only, so all 12 monthly ordinals emit NaN (no prior-year value available — the canonical first-year-no-comparison case). The example demonstrates the YoY request shape (GROUP_DATE host with frequency-via-Params promotion) — the orchestrator reads the host's `frequency` Param (monthly) and promotes it onto the empty `Ref.YoY` marker before handler dispatch. Buffered: the per-frequency prior-period lookup requires the materialised host series.
